note: Places for Savannah-area projects first listed in the SERTP 2026 Preliminary Expansion Plan (OSM export data/region-b/osm-power-sc-ga.json).

endpoints.name: McIntosh
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/121624352 power=substation name=McIntosh Substation operator=Georgia Power voltage=230000 (same feature as gpc:20277 and desc:6888)
endpoints.validation: The plan names McIntosh's 230 kV breaker-and-a-half bus; this is the Georgia Power McIntosh substation next to Plant McIntosh in Effingham County, the same feature used for TEAMS 20277.

endpoints.name: West McIntosh
endpoints.label: West McIntosh
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/121624371 power=substation name='West McIntosh Substation' operator=Georgia Power voltage=500000 (mapper-supplied tags)
endpoints.validation: Exact name match, operator Georgia Power. A distinct substation about 0.46 mi west of McIntosh (way/121624352); it is not treated as the same facility as McIntosh.

projects.notes: West McIntosh is a distinct Georgia Power substation about 0.46 mi from McIntosh (OSM way/121624371 vs way/121624352); it is measured as its own place, never equated with McIntosh.
